svg.title: A solder mask dam between fine-pitch pads
svg.desc: Enlarged and drawn to scale. Top: three pads of a 0.5 mm-pitch part, each 0.25 mm wide with 0.25 mm of space between them. Each pad has its own mask opening, 0.075 mm larger on each side, which leaves a 0.1 mm strip of solder mask, the dam, between neighboring pads. Bottom: the same pads in one large opening with no dams, where solder can bridge from pad to pad.

g.text: 0.075 mm larger than the pad, each side
